name: Arm Holdings plc
business_model: Licenses CPU/GPU/system IP and compute subsystems for licence fees (point-in-time or ratable for subscriptions) plus per-chip royalties accrued on licensees' shipments; announced production silicon (Arm AGI CPU) in March 2026.

name: Photronics, Inc.
business_model: Merchant photomask maker: sells custom mask sets at individually negotiated prices, recognised over time; backlog one to two weeks for IC masks.

name: Alchip Technologies, Limited
business_model: ASIC design-service and production house for system companies: earns milestone NRE plus turnkey production revenue.

name: Cadence Design Systems, Inc.
business_model: EDA software sold mainly as time-based licences invoiced quarterly (recognised over time), plus up-front hardware and IP licences and royalties.

name: Siltronic AG
business_model: Silicon wafer maker selling under long-term agreements and outside them, with customer prepayments.
